deniedGlobals.window: src/sim must not touch the DOM.
deniedGlobals.document: src/sim must not touch the DOM.
deniedGlobals.navigator: src/sim must not touch the DOM.
deniedGlobals.performance: src/sim must use the frame count, not wall-clock time.
deniedGlobals.requestAnimationFrame: src/sim is stepped by main, not rAF.
deniedGlobals.setTimeout: src/sim must use the frame count.
deniedGlobals.setInterval: src/sim must use the frame count.
deniedGlobals.AudioContext: src/sim must not play audio; emit an event.
deniedGlobals.globalThis: src/sim must not reach host globals.
deniedGlobals.self: src/sim must not reach host globals.
deniedGlobals.process: src/sim must not read the host environment.
deniedGlobals.queueMicrotask: src/sim must use the frame count.
deniedGlobals.Date: src/sim must use the frame count, not wall-clock time.
deniedGlobals.Intl: src/sim must not depend on the locale.

patterns.message: src/sim must not import render/debug libraries.
src/sim must not import non-sim code.
src/sim must not import Node APIs.
